dct_description_sm:
This website is an interactive map to help people who are looking for Rent-Geared-to-Income (RGI) housing in the City and County of Peterborough. It includes RGI housing properties, RGI rent supplements and other Affordable Housing properties (with rents ranging from 60% to 100% of market rent).

- The Help Guide includes tips about how to use the map.
- Definitions can help you understand the terms used in the map.
The Help button includes these resources, the HAP application for RGI housing and the contact information to give feedback and comments about this map.

Visit www.peterborough.ca/hap for more information.
